description:
About the job

Responsibilities

Team Introduction

The e-commerce industry has grown tremendously recently, becoming a hotly contested space among leading Internet companies. Its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our campaign team. Together, we can build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure, and intuitive for our users.

Step into a dynamic role with the Mexico operation team, where you'll play a vital part in executing varies campaigns for some of the most iconic brands. Be at the forefront of innovation, contributing to cutting-edge campaigns and driving forward the yearly strategic modules that define success. In this role, you’ll help power the future of e-commerce, supporting high-impact initiatives that connect brands with consumers in meaningful ways. Join us as we shape the future of e-commerce here at TikTok Shop!

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 3 months long internship period.

Responsibilities:

Creator Hunting & Identification (Stage 1)


 Identify and source high-potential fashion creators across TikTok and other social platforms, focusing on those with strong content quality, audience engagement, and commercial potential.
 Analyze creator profiles, content style, audience demographics, and performance metrics to assess fit within - TikTok Shop’s fashion ecosystem.
 Build and maintain a robust pipeline of creators segmented by category (e.g., apparel, footwear, accessories) and content type (live, video, product-driven).


Creator Incubation & Fashion Alignment (Stage 2)


 Support the onboarding and incubation of selected creators by helping define their initial content and monetization strategy.
 Identify and match relevant fashion brands, products, and merchandising strategies based on each creator’s profile, audience, and content style.
 Collaborate with Account Managers to guide creators on best practices for live streaming, product selection, and content optimization.
 Monitor creator development and track their progression from early-stage incubation to revenue-generating contributors.


Performance Tracking & Insights


 Track and analyze both qualitative and quantitative performance metrics, including GMV contribution, content performance, conversion rates, and creator growth.
 Build and maintain dashboards or trackers to measure the effectiveness of the creator incubation program.
 Generate insights on what works (e.g., creator archetypes, product categories, content formats) to continuously refine the strategy.


Project Management & Cross-functional Collaboration


 Support the execution of the creators project roadmap, ensuring timelines and deliverables are met.
 Work closely with Account Managers, marketing, and operations teams to align on creator strategies and opportunities.
 Contribute to continuous improvement of creator sourcing, incubation frameworks, and scaling strategies.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related fields
 Proactive self-learner, open to navigating uncertain and exploratory business scenarios.
 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume.


Preferred Qualifications


 Strong analytical skills, with a structured and critical approach to problem-solving;
 Experience in commerce platforms, digital marketing, or the short video/live streaming industry is highly valued.


Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

description:
About the job

About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest is looking for a Performance Solutions Partner to support their growth in Mexico City. This role is responsible for enabling advertisers and sellers to drive success on the Pinterest platform, through the adoption of priority products and the development of new / innovative best practices. The Performance Solutions Partner will closely partner with cross-functional leadership in sales, product, and engineering. This is a multi-faceted, fast-paced job in a start-up environment so flexibility, a data-driven mindset, a strong work ethic, and a good sense of humor are a must. The right candidate will be a strategic thought leader who is driven by learning and solving ambiguous problems.

The Performance Solutions team sits within the Global Business Org (GBO) organization. Performance Solutions delivers through strategic guidance, operational excellence and technical expertise to improve the effectiveness of advertising campaigns resulting in increased client ROI. We work to understand, innovate, and scale cross-functional workflows. We are responsible for measuring process impact, making our business more efficient with consistent execution while embarking on building the next generation of data-driven best practices.

What You’ll Do


Become an expert at Pinterest campaign best practices, enabling yourself to be your regions go to resource for performance related opportunities
Understand complex processes and products, distilling them down into a digestible format for a less technical audience
Enable and mobilize sellers to pitch new performance products and campaign best practices at scale
Provide strategic thought leadership to top tier clients within your region
Identify key issues facing our clients and advertisers, and develop proposed solutions on how Pinterest should solve them through systems, processes and / or people
Work with your region to adapt best practices to fit the market your are supporting, and relay that feedback to internal and external stakeholders
Use AI and automation to streamline cross-functional workflows, distill complex data into actionable recommendations, and build the next generation of data-driven best practices at scale.



What We’re Looking For


Minimum of 4 years of relevant work experience within digital marketing, ad tech and ad operations
Expertise in digital advertising and media sales including campaign optimization, analytical problem solving, sales facing experience, and product/platform knowledge
A structured and detail-oriented thinker. You’re as comfortable solving conceptual problems and creating frameworks to refine a team’s thinking as you are getting into the weeds to understand how things work.
Strong communication skills. You can move seamlessly between conversing with engineers or frontline sales employees and lead presentations with senior leads.
An individual that thrives in a fast-moving environment and is independently capable of seeking information, corralling resources, and delivering results without waiting for direction.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as economics, marketing, business, or equivalent experience.



Relocation Statement:


 This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.



In-Office Requirement Statement


We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration at least 2-5 times per week. Therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from Mexico City office.



Our Commitment To Inclusion

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support.

 Construir y gestionar un pipeline de cuentas estratégicas de ecommerce, actuando como el principal punto de contacto desde la prospección hasta el lanzamiento de la primera campaña en la plataforma.

 Comprender en profundidad los desafíos, objetivos y estrategias digitales de cada cliente, ofreciendo una consultoría personalizada en todas las etapas de la venta.

 Prospectar y calificar nuevas oportunidades de manera activa.

 Preparar y presentar propuestas y soluciones digitales personalizadas, educando a los clientes sobre el potencial de la plataforma y cómo puede potenciar sus resultados.

 Mínimo 1.5 años de experiencia sólida en ventas consultivas y complejas, con perfil hunter, liderando todo el ciclo (prospección, abordaje, negociación y cierre).

 Fuerte habilidad de comunicación, negociación e influencia en distintos niveles de decisión.

 Capacidad de organizar el pipeline, seguir procesos y actuar de manera disciplinada para garantizar resultados.

Requisitos deseables:



 Experiencia con clientes de e-commerce o soluciones de medios digitales.

 Experiencia trabajando con Agencias de Marketing.

 Historial consistente en apertura y cierre de cuentas estratégicas .

 Facilidad para presentaciones y reuniones con decisores (remoto y presencial).

 Perfil analítico para evaluar oportunidades y resultados.

KPI-driven, highly organized, and able to build simple systems and SOPs as you scale.

description:
About the job

Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist

TopFoxx | Remote | Full-Time

 

Location: Remote (must work U.S. East Coast hours).

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Hours are flexible. We care about performance, not clocks.

Salary: $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.

Language: Perfect written and spoken English is required (this is non-negotiable), along with a deep understanding of U.S. culture, slang, and social media behavior.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned fashion startup reinventing the sunglasses industry with solution-oriented designs and bold branding. Since 2016, we have grown from a bootstrapped e-commerce brand into a global business serving hundreds of thousands of customers, backed by an engaged community of influencers and creators.

We are not here to follow trends. We create them. Our sunglasses are tangle-free, floatable, foldable, shatter-resistant, and sustainably made, and we are just getting started.

We are a small, lean, founder-led team of fewer than ten people, with only about three of us on marketing. That means there is nowhere to hide and no one to pass the work to. Everyone wears multiple hats, owns real outcomes, and what you build genuinely moves the company. We do not do slow. We move fast, we pivot often, and we only hire A-players who treat the business like their own.




The Role

You will be the main one. This is the person who owns influencer and affiliate marketing end to end at TopFoxx. You are not waiting for a manual or a list of tasks. You are expected to bring the strategy, bring the ideas, and then execute them yourself, fast.

This space changes daily. New creators, new trends, new platform rules. You have to move quickly, test constantly, double down on what converts, and cut what does not. We are not looking for someone who only posts and reports. We are looking for a real executor who is proactive, creative, and obsessed with one thing above all: profitable, converting partnerships.

This is a big opportunity, and we want to be honest with you: it is also real work. We already have a large base of affiliates and creators, but your job is to grow it, activate it, and make it far more profitable. This is not a coast-along role. You will be building, pushing, and problem-solving every single day. For the right person, that is exactly the appeal.

This is a high-ownership role with a direct path into leading the influencer marketing function as it scales.




Why This Is Worth It

Here is the honest pitch. This is not a maintenance job and it is not busywork. Influencer and affiliate marketing is one of the biggest growth levers we have, and we believe this channel can become a multi-million dollar engine for TopFoxx. We are looking for the person who can build that.

We reward outcomes, not hours. If you can show us you can grow this and drive real, profitable revenue, you grow with it. That means a clear path into leadership and compensation that reflects the results you create. The ceiling here is high for someone who actually delivers, and you will be able to point to a business you helped build, not just tasks you completed.

If you want to be a small piece of a big machine, this is not it. If you want real ownership, real upside, and to look back in a year knowing you built something that matters, keep reading.




1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Program (Your Primary Focus)

This is the heart of the role and where most of your time and energy goes. The big one is affiliate. Your job is to make sure the affiliates are converting, the program is profitable, and the numbers in TikTok Shop Seller Center are strong and trending up.

Own TikTok Shop Seller Center day to day. Live in the dashboards, know your numbers cold, and make sure performance is healthy across GMV, conversion, and orders.
Make the affiliate program profitable. Track and grow GMV, revenue per creator, sample-to-sales ROI, and commission costs. Protect margin. Every dollar of product and commission has to earn its return.
Build and manage a pipeline of hundreds to thousands of active TikTok Shop affiliates, and keep them actually posting and selling, not just signing up.
Recruit high-converting creators and live sellers who know how to talk about product and drive sales, not just collect free samples.
Go live and sell yourself. You will host TikTok Lives, get on camera, and sell the glasses directly. Then you bring affiliates on, show them how it is done, and coach them to do the same.
Coordinate TikTok Live schedules with strong sellers, secure Spark Ads permissions, and optimize listings and content angles for maximum GMV.
Watch performance weekly. Scale top converters aggressively, and cut low performers fast.
Keep the data honest. No padded numbers, no inflated reporting. Decisions are only as good as the data behind them.




2. Instagram Influencers

Instagram is the second pillar. Here we work on gifting and affiliate only, so your skill is finding the right people and getting them to convert without a paid budget.

Source Instagram influencers who can actually sell, creators who understand product and know how to drive their audience to buy, not just post a pretty photo.
Run gifting-only and affiliate-only collaborations, and move creators from one gift to repeat posting to consistent affiliate sales.
Rebuild our existing relationships. We have lists of past and dormant influencers. A big part of this role is reigniting those relationships and turning old contacts back into active, converting partners.
Build genuine, consistent relationships so TopFoxx stays top of mind, through thoughtful, regular touchpoints across Instagram and DMs.




3. LTK, Affiliate Platforms & Onboarding Calls

The third pillar is affiliate-driven platforms like LTK, and just as important, getting on calls with creators. This role is not behind a screen all day. You have to be outgoing and genuinely good at talking to people.

Recruit and activate creators on LTK and other affiliate networks (Amazon, affiliate links) who are still actively driving commission-based sales.
Run weekly onboarding calls. You will be on calls regularly, onboarding new influencers, walking them through the program, and getting them excited and set up to post.
Get on calls and close collabs. Be confident and persuasive, build rapport quickly, and convince creators to say yes to working with us, often with gifting only.
Understand creator psychology and motivate influencers to post consistently through relationship, community value, and a clear win for them.




4. Strategy, Reporting & Full Influencer Marketing Scope

Because you own this function, you also handle everything a strong e-commerce influencer marketing lead would handle. Study what bigger e-commerce brands do, then adapt the best of it to a lean, fast-moving team.

Build the strategy. Bring a clear point of view on where influencer and affiliate marketing is going and how TopFoxx wins, then put it into action.
Plan and execute campaigns tied to product launches, holidays, seasonal moments, and major sales events (BFCM, summer, new drops).
Manage content calendars, gifting coordination, sample sends, and follow-ups so nothing slips.
Build weekly performance reports that connect activity to revenue, and use them to decide what to scale and what to kill.
Create simple SOPs, trackers, and playbooks as you go, so the program is repeatable and scalable as the team grows.
Collaborate with the creative, marketing, and product teams to keep messaging aligned, and step in on urgent launch-related projects when needed.
Stay ahead of trends, new creators, and new affiliate opportunities before competitors do.
Help with wider marketing as needed. With a team this small, marketing is just three people and everyone pitches in. From time to time things will come up across other marketing areas and departments that need a hand. We need someone proactive and solution-oriented who brings energy, jumps in, and helps build this with us rather than sitting idle.




Who You Are

Proactive: You see the gap and fill it. You bring the plan, you do not wait to be told.
A real executor: You move fast, ship daily, and adapt as things change hour to hour.
Analytical and profit-obsessed: You can read a Seller Center dashboard, understand ROI and margin, and turn data into decisions.
Persuasive and outgoing: You love talking to creators, you are comfortable on camera and on calls, and you can sell the partnership and the product.
Relationship-driven: You are a natural connector who builds loyalty and keeps partners coming back.
Organized under pressure: You can juggle hundreds of moving pieces without dropping the ball.




Required Experience & Skills

2+ years in influencer or affiliate marketing, preferably in fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce / DTC.
Expert, hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop Seller Center mechanics and affiliate programs.
Proven track record of generating real sales through gifting-only or zero-budget strategies.
Comfort with LTK, Amazon, and other affiliate platforms.
Comfortable on camera and hosting TikTok Lives to sell product directly.
Perfect written and spoken English, and a strong understanding of U.S. culture and digital trends. This is genuinely important.
KPI-driven, highly organized, and able to build simple systems and SOPs as you scale.




What You Get

Salary of $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.
A fully remote role on a fast-moving global team.
Real ownership of the influencer and affiliate function, with a path into leadership as it scales.
PTO including vacation, holidays, sick, personal, and mental health days.
Free TopFoxx products and partner brand perks.

Candidatos de : Pachuca/ Actopan (preferentemente). También consideraremos candidatos de Ixmiquilpan si cumplen con el perfil.




¿Quiénes somos?




Enzamble es una empresa mexicana con más de 25 años fabricando mobiliario para hoteles, hospitales, restaurantes, universidades, oficinas y desarrollos inmobiliarios.




Estamos entrando en una nueva etapa de crecimiento digital y buscamos a la persona que lidere esta transformación.

No buscamos alguien que solamente publique en Facebook o Instagram.

Buscamos a quien ayude a construir nuestra presencia digital y genere oportunidades reales de negocio.

Será responsable de desarrollar toda la estrategia digital de la empresa.




Entre sus actividades estarán:




* Crear contenido para LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram y otras plataformas.

* Planear el calendario mensual de publicaciones.

* Tomar fotografías y videos dentro de la fábrica.

No buscamos solamente experiencia.

Buscamos actitud.

Una persona curiosa.

Que proponga ideas.

Que quiera aprender.

Que se emocione viendo crecer una marca.

Que investigue por su cuenta.

Que no espere instrucciones para todo.

* Photoshop

* Meta Business Suite

* Meta Ads

* LinkedIn

* Google Analytics

* Creatividad.

* Organización.

* Atención al detalle.

* Pensamiento analítico.

* Gusto por aprender nuevas herramientas.

* Honestidad

* Responsabilidad

* Compromiso

* Iniciativa

* Disciplina

* Creatividad

* Trabajo en equipo

* Ganas de crecer profesionalmente




Lo que NO buscamos

No buscamos alguien que solamente programe publicaciones.

No buscamos alguien que espere instrucciones todos los días.

No buscamos alguien que vea este trabajo como “otro empleo”.

Queremos una persona que quiera construir algo grande junto con nosotros.

* Capacitación constante.

description:
About the job

Business Cultivation Lead (Location: Mexico City)




Curioso is a collective of architects, interior designers, and artists designing meaningful experiences around the world. Our award-winning projects represent a range of industries, including luxury hospitality, lifestyle hospitality, restaurant, wellness, multifamily, and professional spaces. We're a collaborative studio driven by curiosity, empathy, and an entrepreneurial spirit, with a diverse, multicultural team across our studios in Chicago, IL, and Mérida, Yucatán, México.




We're looking for a Business Cultivation Lead to join our team.







Position Overview




We are looking for a Business Cultivation Lead to work closely alongside our Managing Partner in identifying, pursuing, and winning the right work. This is a senior, independent role for someone who understands the luxury hospitality market deeply. We are looking for someone who has genuine relationships, sharp instincts about where a project is headed, and the discipline to manage a complex pipeline without losing momentum.




This person carries the business development function day-to-day. That means first outreach, relationship stewardship, RFP analysis, go/no-go discipline, fee structuring, and conference presence — with the judgment to know when to bring in others and when to move independently. You will not be executing someone else's strategy. You will be building it as part of a strategic team.




We are looking for someone who is bilingual, at home in both U.S. and Latin American hospitality markets, understanding what makes a studio like Curioso distinct — and why that distinction matters when you're sitting across from a developer who has ten firms in their inbox.




Responibilities




Pipeline & Market Intelligence




Maintain a rigorous, current view of the pipeline: active pursuits, warm relationships, and longer-horizon opportunities, using CRM with discipline and consistency
Monitor RFP activity, industry movements, and developer news across the U.S., Mexico, and CALA to identify opportunities before they become formal solicitations
Track the competitive landscape: who is winning what work, where Curioso is well-positioned, and where we're underrepresented




Pursuit Strategy & Go/No-Go




Lead the go/no-go evaluation for each incoming opportunity: assessing fee potential, scope fit, competitive position, client profile, and strategic alignment
Develop pursuit strategy for each active proposal: what to lead with, what to show, who the right contact is, and how to frame Curioso's value in this specific context
Build and manage the fee calculation process: understanding Curioso's internal cost structure, the right fee range for a given scope, and presenting a clear rationale internally before any number goes to a client




Relationship Development




Maintain and grow a personal network of developers, operators, brand owners, architects, and consultants across U.S., Mexico, and CALA markets
Lead first-contact outreach for new opportunities, representing Curioso with warmth, precision, and genuine curiosity about the project
Own pre-proposal relationship conversations: discovery calls, site visits, and early alignment meetings — and translate what you learn into a pursuit strategy
Represent Curioso at key industry conferences (BDNY, Hospitality Design, HVS events, regional events in Mexico and the Caribbean) with a clear plan for who to see and what to advance




Proposal & Pitch Leadership




Lead the proposal process end-to-end: structuring the narrative, coordinating with the BD Designer on production, reviewing for accuracy and tone, and delivering on time
Translate complex project information into clear, client-facing language — fee structures, scope definitions, process explanations — without losing the story
Work with the Managing Partner to prepare for and lead presentations and shortlist interviews




Internal Alignment




Keep studio owners and senior leadership aligned on pursuit status, decision points, and pipeline health — creating visibility without creating noise
Flag misaligned opportunities early and frame the decision clearly: here's what we'd be saying yes to, here's what we'd be declining, here's why







Requirements




8+ years of experience in business development, client relations, or strategic pursuit roles within luxury hospitality design, architecture, or a closely related field
Genuine fluency in the luxury hospitality development landscape — you know the developers, operators, and brands that matter, and you understand how projects are financed, structured, and selected
Bilingual in English and Spanish, with active relationships in Mexico and/or CALA markets
Based in or willing to relocate to Miami, Florida, OR located in Mexico City or Mérida, with expectation of regular U.S. travel
Strong analytical instincts: you can read a scope, calculate a fee, assess a competitive field, and make a clear recommendation
A communicator who writes and speaks with clarity and precision
Deeply curious about design, hospitality, culture, and place — this is not a role for someone who sells services they don't believe in
Comfortable with ambiguity and a rigorous pace — this is a growing studio, not a process-heavy institution







What This Is Not




This is not a coordinator role with a senior title. We need someone who will have their own relationships, make their own calls, and build something — not someone executing a checklist. If you need to be told where to look for opportunities or how to frame a pursuit, this role is not the right fit.




We also need someone who is genuinely selective on our behalf. The discipline to say "this isn't the right project for us" is as important as the ability to close. Curioso's value position depends on the quality of our choices, not the volume of our proposals.







Compensation




Competitive base salary commensurate with experience. Performance alignment tied to studio growth. Benefits package included. Travel expected.

About the job

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’re Expected To


Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;

Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

description:
About the job

Remote | Full-time | Fluent English Required

Time: 9-6pm EST (Hours are flexible, we care about performance not clocks).

Salary based on Experience: Starting USD $900-$1400+ with performance bonuses.




TopFoxx is a fast growing women owned DTC sunglasses and accessories brand. Our slogan is “sunglasses with a solution.” We create innovative, functional luxury eyewear such as floating sunglasses, tangle free aviators, foldable pocket sunnies, mood boosting lenses, and more. We are a lean, fast moving ecommerce company with a limited budget. This is a multi hat Operations Manager role for someone who is tech savvy, analytical, resourceful, and confident leading execution across teams.




Your primary responsibility will be owning vendor operations and the global supply chain. This includes managing Chinese suppliers, coordinating with our fulfillment center, building production timelines, maintaining quality control, ensuring inventory is restocked ahead of demand, negotiating costs, and preventing operational issues before they become problems.

You will also manage the technical operational infrastructure of the business. This includes Shopify backend systems, integrations between software platforms, APIs, ecommerce tools, and automation systems that support both operations and marketing. You must be highly comfortable working across software platforms and implementing systems that improve efficiency. A key part of this role is building operational structure that does not currently exist. You will be responsible for creating timelines, SOPs, documentation, automation workflows, and operational systems that allow the company to scale while saving the team time and reducing company costs.

You should be someone who constantly looks for ways to save time, cut unnecessary costs, improve workflows, and build systems that make the business run faster and more efficiently. This role requires a person who brings energy, ownership, and solutions. Someone who is always learning, improving themselves, and finding smarter ways to solve problems.

The goal of this role is simple. Save the company money and save the team time. Time is money. Your job is to make sure the company runs faster, smarter, and more efficiently every day.




Core Responsibilities1. Vendor Operations, Global Supply Chain, and Logistics (primary responsibility)

• Managing relationships with Chinese suppliers, factories, and production partners, while sourcing and onboarding new suppliers.

•Negotiating pricing, terms, refunds, and cost reductions with suppliers and vendors, researching & creating contracts based on country origin. 

 • Owning the global supply chain from production through fulfillment

 • Forecasting inventory needs and managing production timelines to ensure inventory arrives ahead of demand while avoiding both stockouts and overstock

 • Overseeing supplier shipments and fulfillment center logistics to ensure accurate, fast, and efficient order flow

 • Proactively & ahead, overseeing rigorous quality control across suppliers products and fulfillment partners

 • Proactively identifying operational risks and implementing contingency plans, buffers, and preventative systems to avoid supply chain disruptions

 • Identifying cost reduction opportunities across vendors, logistics partners, and operational expenses

 •Auditing fulfillment center invoices, shipping charges, and logistics costs to ensure pricing accuracy and prevent overbilling




2. Technical Operations, Shopify Infrastructure, and Integrations

• Managing Shopify backend systems and operational configurations

 • Connecting Shopify with apps and operational tools through APIs and integrations

 • Ensuring ecommerce systems such as TikTok Shop, fulfillment software, and marketing tools integrate correctly

 • Implementing automation workflows using platforms such as Zapier and AI based tools

 • Troubleshooting issues across ecommerce systems, integrations, and operational platforms

 • Building automations, integrations, and technical systems that reduce manual work and save the team time

 • Using AI tools and automation platforms to streamline workflows and operational processes across the company

 • Supporting website updates, product page adjustments, landing page changes, and operational improvements within Shopify

 • Monitoring user behavior tools such as Hotjar and implementing website improvements based on insights

 • Coordinating with freelance developers when more advanced development work is required

You must be comfortable working across software platforms and implementing technical systems that improve operational efficiency.




3. Operational Analytics, Cost Reduction, and Financial Awareness

• Monitoring operational expenses and identifying opportunities/inefficiencies to reduce costs 

 • Reviewing vendor invoices and preventing unnecessary charges or fees

 • Auditing company software subscriptions and operational tools to eliminate unnecessary spend and staying on top monthly costs.

 • Building operational dashboards and reporting to track performance and operational metrics

title: Spanish (Latin America) Language Data Contributor (Multimodal) – Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
About the job

Are you a Spanish (Latin America) language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication for Spanish speakers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Spanish (Latin America) language specialists who live and breathe phonetics, morphology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics, and sociolinguistics of the Spanish language. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like verb conjugation, noun-adjective agreement, subjunctive usage, sentence structure, regional dialects, word order, idiomatic expressions, and cultural nuances—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A degree in Spanish language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal; peer‑reviewed publications, teaching experience, or hands‑on linguistic analysis projects signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Spanish language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Data Collection & Participation Notice

This engagement involves participation in AI data collection and evaluation. Services include providing audio, video, image, and written inputs—including recordings of your voice and likeness—to support the development and refinement of AI systems.

Eligibility for this project requires that you are 18 years or older and agree to the applicable participant and consent agreements.

When providing services, submit content featuring only yourself. Avoid the inclusion of third-party or sensitive personal information to maintain project security standards.

About the job

Hello! 👋🏽

At Factorial we're looking for a new Onboarding Specialist for the LATAM Market to help us boost the company to the next level. 🦄

Ready to be part of the challenge?🚀

The Role 📜

As an Onboarding Specialist, you will play a critical role in shaping the first experience our customers have with Factorial. This is not just implementation — this is where customers decide to fully adopt and believe in our product.

You will be responsible for leading end-to-end onboarding processes, ensuring customers successfully implement Factorial and adapt it to their internal HR and operational workflows.

⚠️ Note: This is not an HR onboarding role — it is a consultative, client-facing role that is part of our post-sales process.

One of your biggest challenges will be to deeply understand each client’s processes, identify gaps, and translate their needs into a scalable and effective setup within Factorial — making them feel confident they made the right decision.

What will you be doing:


Own and lead the onboarding journey for new LATAM customers from kickoff to full activation
Design and execute a tailored onboarding roadmap for each client, aligning timelines, milestones, and success criteria
Guide clients through implementation via video calls and email, ensuring adoption of key features and workflows
Bring a consultative approach, helping clients translate their HR processes into Factorial in a scalable and efficient way
Act as the main point of contact during onboarding, ensuring alignment, visibility, and momentum at every stage
Identify risks, blockers, and opportunities early, coordinating with internal teams (Product, Support, Sales) to resolve them
Collect and structure customer feedback, turning insights into actionable improvements for Product and CX
Drive a best-in-class onboarding experience, ensuring clients feel supported, confident, and excited about using Factorial.


Your Profile 🧐 


Strong ownership & problem-solving mindset: You take full responsibility for your clients’ onboarding success. You proactively identify challenges, align stakeholders, and ensure solutions are implemented — making the client feel you’ve got their back at all times.
Consultative & analytical thinking: You are able to deeply understand client processes and translate them into structured, scalable solutions within the platform.
Customer-centric mindset: You know this is a critical moment in the customer journey, and you focus on delivering an experience that builds trust, engagement, and long-term retention.
Fast learner & product-driven: You quickly become an expert in the product, stay up to date with new features, and feel empowered to ask questions and challenge the status quo to improve how we work.
Cross-functional collaboration: You are comfortable working with multiple teams to unblock issues, ensuring visibility and progress for your clients.
Strong communication skills: You can clearly guide clients, manage expectations, and adapt your communication to different stakeholders.
Languages:
Native Spanish
Intermediate English (you will participate in internal meetings in English regularly)
Experience:
Previous experience in Onboarding, Implementation, Customer Success, or similar client-facing roles

Experience working with SaaS products and/or HR processes is highly valued.

Benefits 🎉

Perks of being part of our team!!


High-growth, multicultural, and friendly environment.
Language exchange at Factorial.
Grocery vouchers 🍜
Free coffee and tea ☕️
Private health insurance, including nutrition and therapy support.
Wellhub (Gympass) 🧘🏻‍♀️
Hybrid work model and shorter Fridays.
Breakfast and snacks 🥞🍒


Factorial is an all-in-one HR software and a fast-growing company founded in 2016. Our mission is to help SMEs automate HR workflows, centralize employee data, and make better business decisions. Currently, we serve thousands of customers across more than 60 countries and a wide range of industries. We’ve built a highly diverse and multicultural team of over 900 people across our offices in Barcelona, Brazil, Mexico, and the United States. 🌎

Our Values 🫀

We own it: We take responsibility for every project. We make decisions, not excuses.

We learn and teach: We are committed to learning something new every day and, above all, sharing it.

We partner: Every decision is a team decision. We trust each other.

We grow fast: We act fast. We believe the worst mistake is not learning from mistakes.

description:
About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Specialist, Customer Success Operations & Enablement

Overview

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

 As a Customer Success Sr. Specialist for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. The candidate will focus on ensuring the priority customers and segments they work with experience positive change through more effective use of Services network products. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:


 Engage with stakeholders to study the viability of proposed solutions and understand cyber threats in financial and payment sectors
 Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products
 Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them



Growing The Business:


 Leverage Mastercard Services’ offerings to achieve customer goals and realize value propositions of Mastercard products
 Identify opportunities for additional Mastercard products to create greater value potential for customers and enhance impact of Network Product offerings
 Ability to evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements ensuring product business cases are financially viable and supported by solid data



Technical & Program Readiness:


 Develop training materials, thought leadership, and customer-facing playbooks that can be scaled internally and externally to support customer priorities and Customer Success value proposition
 Translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points. Use stakeholder insights to refine value propositions and improve products



All About You:


 Experience managing clients or internal stakeholders
 Logical, structured thinking, and affinity for numerical analysis
 Advanced Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills
 Undergraduate degree with work experience in consulting, corporate strategy, business intelligence, business line management, or product management
 Experienced at leveraging insights from market analysis, customer engagements, and identified opportunities to inform strategic decisions, drive innovation, and sustain competitive advantage
 Knowledge and understanding of payments technology or cybersecurity (threat intelligence or risk management) and application of that knowledge to address customer/market needs in these areas are a plus
 Experience using tools and technology to provide data analytics and business intelligence on cyber threats, fraud, risk and vulnerability
 Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Experience in analyzing customer metrics and leveraging data to drive customer success initiatives that contribute to mutual profitability and growth
 Experience in identifying “next opportunity” for customers to further enhance the strength and value of the partnership for both parties
 Experience in creative thinking and development of innovative solutions to complex customer challenges
 Enthusiastic individual who works seamlessly with a diverse high performing team, nurtures a winning and inclusive culture, and a focus on development at the individual and team level
 Experience working with at least some of the following: large and emerging Technology, Financial Services, Acquirers/Processors, Service Providers, and/or digital platform partners



Spanish and fluent English (advanced Portuguese highly desirable)

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

About the job

Role highlights


Customer Excellence Specialist
Location: Mexico, Chile, or Colombia
Department: Customer Excellence
Reports to: Senior Customer Excellence Manager
Employment type: Permanent
Workplace model: Remote
Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)


Why this role matters

As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you’ll be the vital link between ICEYE’s SAR satellite capabilities and our customers across the LATAM region — ensuring every order, from submission to final delivery, runs smoothly and every customer interaction leaves a lasting impression.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world’s largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your Day-to-day Responsibilities

Regular Customer Excellence Responsibilities

Order Management


Oversee the entire order process, from submission to the delivery of the final product.
Prepare comprehensive feasibility studies for satellite imagery, ensuring customer requirements are met.


Satellite Resource Planning


Plan satellite resources for capturing Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images.
Perform SAR image quality control to maintain high standards.


Customer Interaction


Resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (satellite operators, sales, analytics, product software) to address project and customer-related issues.
Serve as a vital interface between clients and ICEYE, ensuring effective communication and interaction.


Process Improvement


Contribute to the enhancement of existing processes and documentation.
Report to management on key performance metrics and anomalies.


Product Knowledge


Maintain a thorough understanding of the company’s products, support, and services.


Account Management Responsibilities

Governmental and Commercial Contracts:


Serve as the point of contact for governmental contracts and commercial clients.
Conduct feasibility studies and effectively communicate results to customers.


Relationship Building


Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers, serving as a key contact for order-related queries.


Training And Progress Monitoring


Coordinate and conduct service training for both internal and external customers.
Monitor order progress closely, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.


Reporting


Satisfy internal and external reporting needs by providing accurate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).


What We’re Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in Geography, Remote Sensing, Aerospace, or a related field.
Proven experience in a customer excellence, account management, or customer-facing operations role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills,Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Availability for shift work (no night shifts required).


Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)


Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.


Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

You’ll set the direction, manage milestones, and ensure every detail meets our high standards – from reviewing contracts to final handovers. You’ll partner closely with customers, internal teams, and subcontractors, coordinating engineering, operations, logistics, and services to deliver technically sound and commercially successful results. By controlling project budgets and timelines while building strong relationships across disciplines, you’ll play a key role in keeping energy flowing efficiently and reliably. With opportunities to travel – sometimes internationally – you’ll expand your impact and grow your career in a diverse, collaborative, and future-focused organization.

How You’ll Make An Impact


Manage all phases of transformer warranty projects, from inception to completion, ensuring measurable success in quality, budget, and schedule.
Develop comprehensive project plans and communication strategies between customers and Siemens Energy stakeholders.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. About the job

Description

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to join the Amazon Payments Mexico marketing team. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded owner of marketing execution for one or more payment products within the Amazon Mexico ecosystem. You will be responsible for converting marketing strategy into customer-facing outcomes through hands-on, week-by-week execution across onsite merchandising, promotions, performance reporting, and competitive intelligence.

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity role where you will manage the full execution lifecycle — from campaign creation and promotional configuration to post-campaign analysis — operating within Amazon's rigorous weekly business review cadence.

Key job responsibilities

Onsite Merchandising

Own all customer-facing placements on Amazon.com.mx including Maple campaigns (High Upsell Cards, Mobile View Cards, Priceblock banners, Wallet placements), DPIC content, Sparkle keyword campaigns, homepage hero banners, and landing pages

Manage creative briefing, review, scheduling coordination, and multi-channel QA across mobile, app, and desktop

Execute large-scale campaign rotations during High-Velocity Events (40+ onsite campaigns and 5–8 landing pages per event)

Configure targeting by card issuer and customer segment

Promotions & Discounts

Design promotional strategies for assigned payment products and navigate approval workflows with Finance and Legal

Configure promotions in relevant systems (PAWS, IBD coupon architecture, cashback configurations)

Coordinate with up to 14 issuing bank partners on offer structures, communication timing, and shared funding

Maintain a rolling pipeline of promotions planned quarters ahead and deliver post-promotion ROI reporting

Monitoring & Reporting

Produce weekly flash reports, WBR/MBR data pulls, and monthly deep-dive analyses

Maintain dashboards, detect anomalies, and deliver post-campaign performance reports and QBR inputs

Provide the feedback loop that determines campaign effectiveness, segment conversion, and budget efficiency

Competitive Intelligence

Conduct monthly structured competitive scans covering MercadoLibre, Liverpool, Coppel, major issuing banks, and emerging fintechs

Track feature launches, promotional mechanics, pricing changes, onsite merchandising tactics, and media spend shifts

Deliver intel summaries to the broader team and product partners

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

Write campaign briefs, BRDs, 1-pagers, and post-mortem narratives

Participate in weekly syncs with product managers, agency partners, legal/compliance reviews, and team ceremonies

Operate within Amazon's written communication culture and weekly business review cadence

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

 8+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English

About the job

Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $510,000 - $612,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $510,000 - $587,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America's most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn't, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we've built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they're proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You'll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes.

Working Within Our Values:

At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required.

Your focus of responsibilities will be: 


Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You're responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.
Client: Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we're addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.
People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.
Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation.
Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We're committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you'll familiarize yourself with Thrive's tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you'll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You'll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you'll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. 


Qualifications


You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).
You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level.
You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools.
You've managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals.
You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You've resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables.
You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.
