title: Paid Search Specialist
skills: Build, launch, and maintain Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, and inventory realities; surface trade‑offs and clarifying questions early.
Prepare clear, on‑time performance updates and inputs for QBRs with actionable next steps.
Operate platform tooling (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), audience/keyword tools, and feed basics; apply automation responsibly (e.g., smart bidding, Performance Max) with guidance.
Pull and interpret Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) to inform day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback to product/analytics channels.
Monitor daily/weekly performance; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/B tests with defined success criteria; maintain pacing and budgets.
Execute tagging and feed QA checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.
Demonstrate sound channel craft and growing cross‑channel awareness; connect measurement to growth; follow and help refine team playbooks and SOPs.
Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time; proactively flag risks/blockers; reduce rework and non‑converting spend; close the loop with documented learnings.
Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace technology and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.
Experience: 2–3 years executing and managing Paid Search/Shopping (builds, launches, pacing, optimizations); monthly budgets ~$50K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights; familiarity with Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4 and advanced Excel/Sheets (pivots, lookups); able to create clear performance narratives and basic test readouts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear written/verbal status updates; cross‑functional teamwork in a Pod; receptive to coaching and able to “manage up.”
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a strong advantage.
Delivery excellence: On‑time, accurate launches and reporting; clean QA (low defect rate).
Efficient growth support: Day‑to‑day optimizations that support efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue goals.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting queries; improve feed/tagging fidelity.
Product/AI usage: Adopt relevant automation and Bliss Point insights with documented impact.
Experimentation: Execute prioritized tests with clear success criteria and learnings.
Collaboration & communication: Clear handoffs, risk flags, and QBR inputs that inform decisions.
description:
About the job

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Search Specialist, you will execute and optimize Paid Search and Shopping campaigns to drive efficient client growth. You’ll build high‑quality account structures, translate performance data into clear next actions, and apply automation and Bliss Point insights under guidance to reduce waste and improve outcomes. You’ll set and deliver Rocks with directional KPIs, partner across your Pod (Channel SMEs, Analytics, Creative, Client Leads, Product/Bliss Point), and continuously document and improve your workflows. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric


Build, launch, and maintain Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, and inventory realities; surface trade‑offs and clarifying questions early.
Prepare clear, on‑time performance updates and inputs for QBRs with actionable next steps.


Product‑Led


Operate platform tooling (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), audience/keyword tools, and feed basics; apply automation responsibly (e.g., smart bidding, Performance Max) with guidance.
Pull and interpret Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) to inform day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback to product/analytics channels.


Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor daily/weekly performance; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/B tests with defined success criteria; maintain pacing and budgets.
Execute tagging and feed QA checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.


The Tinuiti Way


Demonstrate sound channel craft and growing cross‑channel awareness; connect measurement to growth; follow and help refine team playbooks and SOPs.


Owner Mindset


Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time; proactively flag risks/blockers; reduce rework and non‑converting spend; close the loop with documented learnings.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace technology and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


Experience: 2–3 years executing and managing Paid Search/Shopping (builds, launches, pacing, optimizations); monthly budgets ~$50K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights; familiarity with Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4 and advanced Excel/Sheets (pivots, lookups); able to create clear performance narratives and basic test readouts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear written/verbal status updates; cross‑functional teamwork in a Pod; receptive to coaching and able to “manage up.”
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a strong advantage.


KPIs


Delivery excellence: On‑time, accurate launches and reporting; clean QA (low defect rate).
Efficient growth support: Day‑to‑day optimizations that support efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue goals.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting queries; improve feed/tagging fidelity.
Product/AI usage: Adopt relevant automation and Bliss Point insights with documented impact.
Experimentation: Execute prioritized tests with clear success criteria and learnings.
Collaboration & communication: Clear handoffs, risk flags, and QBR inputs that inform decisions.

description:
About the job

Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $607,000 - $789,000 MXN + Profit Sharing (after 1 year of employment) + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $607,000 - $744,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

title: Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
About the job

Acerca de Emeritus

En Emeritus creemos que los líderes construyen del mundo un lugar mejor. Nuestra misión es democratizar el acceso a educación de clase mundial, colaborando con las mejores escuelas de negocio del planeta — MIT Sloan, Columbia Business School, Tuck School of Business, entre otras. Ofrecemos cursos, certificados y maestrías en inglés, español, mandarín y portugués, impactando a más de 300,000 estudiantes en +100 países.




Acerca del Puesto

El Marketing Automation Specialist será el arquitecto de los flujos de comunicación digital que guían a los prospectos desde el primer intento de contacto hasta la inscripción en programas de Emeritus. Esta persona será responsable de diseñar, implementar y optimizar journeys automatizados en Salesforce Marketing Cloud, gestionar campañas multicanal (email y WhatsApp), y medir el impacto de cada acción con KPIs claros.

El rol requiere una mentalidad analítica y orientada a resultados: entender el origen y comportamiento de los prospectos, explorar patrones de interacción, detectar oportunidades de mejora y colaborar con equipos de Performance, Ventas y Producto para maximizar la tasa de inscripción.




Funciones Principales

1. Diseño e Implementación de Flujos Automatizados

• Mapear y comprender las fuentes de prospectos (paid media, orgánico, referidos, alianzas) y sus comportamientos para diseñar customer journeys relevantes.

• Diseñar, construir y lanzar flujos automatizados en Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio) alineados a cada etapa del funnel.

• Definir lógicas de segmentación, personalización y ramificaciones basadas en comportamiento (aperturas, clics, formularios, tiempo en el funnel).

• Proponer y desarrollar nuevas automatizaciones para mejorar la conversión y la eficiencia operativa del equipo.

• Coordinar con redactores y diseñadores para solicitar los copies y materiales necesarios para cada flujo.




2. Gestión de Campañas y Envíos

• Ejecutar campañas automatizadas y envíos manuales (email y WhatsApp) garantizando correcta segmentación, personalización y calendarización.

• Configurar templates responsivos y asegurar su correcta renderización en múltiples clientes de correo.

• Dar seguimiento a indicadores clave: open rate, CTR, entregabilidad, tasa de bajas y conversión.

• Generar insights accionables a partir del análisis de resultados para iterar y mejorar campañas de forma continua.




3. Medición, Análisis y Optimización con KPIs

• Definir y monitorear KPIs de cada flujo automatizado: tasa de apertura, tasa de conversión por etapa, costo por lead calificado, tiempo promedio en el funnel.

• Generar reportes periódicos de desempeño de campañas y journeys con análisis comparativo.

• Proponer y ejecutar pruebas A/B (asunto, copy, horario de envío, CTA) para optimizar resultados.

• Identificar cuellos de botella en los flujos y proponer mejoras basadas en datos para incrementar el número de inscritos.

• Colaborar en la construcción de dashboards de seguimiento con el equipo de BI o Performance.




4. Gestión de Landing Pages y Contenido

• Desarrollar y publicar landing pages en Contentful (CMS), asegurando alineación con lineamientos de marca y objetivos de conversión.

• Coordinar la correcta implementación de materiales digitales (banners, formularios, UTMs).

• Colaborar en la generación de contenido para campañas (email, WhatsApp, LP) con enfoque en conversión.




5. Coordinación y Trabajo en Equipo

• Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de Performance, Ventas y Producto para alinear flujos con objetivos comerciales.

• Apoyar en la ejecución de materiales y campañas para lanzamientos de nuevos programas.

• Gestionar solicitudes derivadas de flujos automatizados (leads, materiales, LPs) con agilidad y criterio.

• Participar activamente en reuniones de planeación, retrospectivas y sesiones de mejora continua.




KPIs de Éxito del Rol

KPI / Métrica Objetivo / Referencia

Tasa de apertura de emails ≥ 25% promedio en flujos clave

Click-Through Rate (CTR) ≥ 3% en campañas de nurturing

Tasa de conversión por etapa del funnel Mejora trimestral sostenida

Número de inscritos generados por flujos automatizados Meta definida por campaña/programa

Entregabilidad de emails ≥ 95% (spam rate < 0.1%)

Tiempo de implementación de nuevos flujos < 5 días hábiles para flujos estándar

Uptime de journeys activos 99% sin interrupciones no planificadas

NPS interno (satisfacción de equipos

colaboradores) ≥ 4/5 trimestral




Requisitos del Candidato

Educación y Experiencia

• Licenciatura en Comunicación, Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Sistemas o afín.

• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en Marketing Automation, CRM o Email Marketing.

• Experiencia comprobable con Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder).

• Experiencia en diseño y análisis de flujos de comunicación automatizada orientados a conversión.




Habilidades Técnicas

• Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC): Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio — nivel avanzado.

• Conocimiento de AMPscript o SQL para personalización dinámica de contenido (deseable).

• HTML y CSS para maquetación de emails responsivos.

• Manejo de plataformas de mensajería: WhatsApp Business API o similares.

• CMS: Contentful o equivalente para gestión de landing pages.

• Dominio de MS Office / Google Workspace; Excel avanzado para análisis de datos.

• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (lectura de documentación técnica y comunicación con equipos globales).




Competencias Clave

• Pensamiento analítico y orientado a datos — toma de decisiones basada en métricas.

• Visión de funnel — capacidad de entender el recorrido del prospecto de inicio a fin.

• Atención al detalle — cero errores en envíos masivos y configuración de journeys.

• Proactividad — capacidad de identificar oportunidades de mejora sin esperar instrucciones.

• Trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva con áreas multidisciplinarias.

• Autogestión y manejo del tiempo en modalidad 100% home office.

• Orientación a resultados — enfoque constante en incrementar el número de inscritos.




Deseable (Nice to Have)

• Certificación en Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Specialist o Marketing Cloud Consultant).

• Experiencia en sector EdTech o empresas de suscripción con funnels de conversión complejos.

• Conocimiento de herramientas de analytics: GA4, Looker Studio, Tableau o Power BI.

• Experiencia con pruebas A/B y metodologías de optimización de conversión (CRO).

• Conocimiento básico de APIs REST para integración de fuentes de prospectos.




¿Por qué unirte a Emeritus?

• Impacto real: tus flujos automatizados conectarán a miles de profesionales con las mejores universidades del mundo.

• Crecimiento acelerado: empresa global en expansión con oportunidades de desarrollo internacional.

• Tecnología de punta: trabajarás con Salesforce Marketing Cloud en escala real de LATAM.

• Equipo de alto desempeño: colaborarás con expertos en performance, ventas y producto.

• Flexibilidad: 100% home office con horarios estables y cultura orientada a resultados.

• Prestaciones superiores: IMSS completo + Seguro de Vida + Gastos Médicos Mayores desde el día 1.

description:
About the job

About the job




Remote | Full-time or Part time | Fluent English Required

Time: 9-6pm EST (Hours are flexible, we care about performance not clocks).

Salary based on Experience: Starting USD $1500 - $2000. 




About Topfoxx

TopFoxx is a woman-owned sunglasses brand designed in NYC. We don't make glasses that just look good we make glasses that solve problems. Our tangle-free aviators, floating sunglasses, foldable shades, UV400 lenses, and shatter-resistant designs are built for real people. We're a small, remote team, which means we move fast and every person we bring on has a real impact.




We are growing. That growth is driven by performance creative ads that convert, content that earns attention, and a team that understands the difference between looking good and actually selling.




What this role actually is:

This is not a traditional video editing role. This is a performance creative position where video editing is the primary skill but the job is to drive conversions, not just produce content. If your mindset is purely aesthetic, this is not the right fit. If you think in hooks, value props, and buyer psychology while you edit, keep reading.




The last person in this role grew it from video editor into Creative Media Manager collaborating across paid media, organic social, creative, marketing, and influencer teams. We're not expecting you to start there, but we do expect the ceiling to be high. Therefore we are hiring a Paid Media Video Editor who can bring bold ideas to life that convert, drive revenue through design, and elevate our brand visually across every touchpoint. This role blends strategic paid media, marketing performance, video editing, creative direction, and leadership. As the Paid Media Video Editor whose primary focus is creating ads that convert you will take raw footage (UGC, product clips, internal shoots) and turn it into scroll-stopping, conversion-driven video ads for Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. We don’t need cinematic edits, we need clear, smart, persuasive short form videos that make people click “Buy.” You will work underneth the marketing manager.




This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who moves fast, understands selling through short video form, and thrives in a small business/startup environment where creative output directly impacts revenue.




If you’re someone who wants to make money with your creativity, execute fast, think like a marketer, and lead a creative vision, this is your role.




Here is the exact type of videos looking for you to make:

https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country=ALL&is_targeted_country=false&media_type=all&search_type=page&sort_data[direction]=desc&sort_data[mode]=total_impressions&view_all_page_id=441539569357988




Your primary mission:

Turn offers, products, and real customer stories into video ads that make people click 'Buy.' Every edit you make serves one goal: revenue.




Your main platform is Meta (Facebook + Instagram) and TikTok. You will support organic social content as needed but paid ads are the core focus.




What You’ll DoPaid Ad Content (Primary Focus)

• Create vertical video ads for TikTok, Instagram, Meta & Facebook

• Develop multiple hook variations, angles, and pacing structures

• Edit videos using a clear problem → solution → outcome framework

• Optimize for CTR, thumb-stop rate, retention, and conversion intent

• Build high-performing UGC-style and influencer-style ads

• Repurpose and remix clips into new testable variations

• Select the most compelling 10–15 seconds from longer footage

• Apply strong, readable on-screen copy that drives action




Supporting & UGC / Organic Content (Secondary)

• Edit short-form product + site videos to improve CVR

• Turn influencer + internal footage into organic-style content

title: Gerente de Comunicación de Marca
description:
About the job

📍 Ubicación: Zapopan, Jalisco

💰 Sueldo: $50,000 mensuales nominales o negociable según experiencia y trayectoria profesional.

🕒 Horario: Lunes a jueves de 7:30 a.m. a 4:45 p.m. | Viernes de 7:30 a.m. a 3:00 p.m.




En Fashion Beauty Group buscamos un líder estratégico para integrarse como Gerente Corporativo de Comunicación de Marca, una posición clave dentro de la Dirección de Mercadotecnia FBG.

Este puesto será responsable de construir, proteger y evolucionar el valor de las marcas de FBG mediante una comunicación estratégica, consistente y diferenciada, alineando todos los puntos de contacto con la identidad, personalidad, promesa y objetivos comerciales del grupo.




Objetivo del puesto

Diseñar, dirigir y gobernar la estrategia integral de comunicación de marca de FBG, asegurando que cada campaña, lanzamiento, pieza gráfica, video, contenido digital, evento, material comercial, comunicación institucional y expresión visual fortalezca el posicionamiento, la preferencia, la reputación y el valor de las marcas del grupo.




Alcance del puesto

Gerencia estratégica transversal con responsabilidad sobre:

• Portafolio de marcas actuales y futuras de FBG.

• Definición y custodia de identidad visual, verbal y conceptual.

• Lineamientos para campañas comerciales, institucionales, digitales y de punto de venta.

• Alineación de comunicación con Trade Marketing, Relaciones Públicas y Marketing Digital.

• Validación de comunicación en lanzamientos, promociones, eventos, activaciones y materiales comerciales.

• Gestión de manuales de identidad, estilo editorial, tono, narrativa y arquitectura de marcas.

• Acompañamiento estratégico a Dirección General y Dirección Comercial en mensajes clave.




Principales responsabilidades

• Definir el Plan Maestro de Comunicación de Marca anual, alineado al plan de marketing, calendario comercial, lanzamientos, temporadas, eventos, expansión y prioridades de Dirección General.

• Custodiar y actualizar el Brand Book corporativo y los manuales de identidad de cada marca, asegurando su aplicación correcta en medios digitales, físicos, retail, presentaciones, empaques y comunicación institucional.

• Desarrollar la arquitectura de marca del portafolio FBG, clarificando la relación entre marcas, líneas, submarcas, campañas y formatos comerciales.

• Definir tono de voz, personalidad, estilo narrativo, lenguaje verbal, storytelling, claims y mensajes clave para cada marca y comunicación corporativa.

• Dirigir conceptualmente campañas 360°, asegurando coherencia entre idea creativa, mensaje, diseño, ejecución digital, trade marketing y relaciones públicas.

• Coordinar el proceso creativo desde brief, concepto, copy, diseño, producción, aprobación y liberación de materiales.

• Asegurar que los contenidos digitales respondan al Modelo de Objetivos Estratégicos de Marketing (MOEM), equilibrando producto, marca, comunidad, experiencia, retail, lifestyle y liderazgo de categoría.

• Supervisar la comunicación institucional de FBG ante colaboradores, aliados, centros comerciales, socios comerciales y otros stakeholders.

• Coordinar con Marketing Digital la adaptación de mensajes para plataformas como Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, LinkedIn, email y web.

• Coordinar con Trade Marketing el desarrollo de mensajes, visuales y materiales para punto de venta, activaciones, POP, visibility, exhibiciones, aperturas y eventos comerciales.

• Coordinar con Relaciones Públicas la narrativa de marca para medios, influencers, voceros, eventos, comunicados, alianzas y reputación externa.

• Asegurar que las piezas audiovisuales, fotográficas y gráficas cumplan estándares de marca, calidad creativa y alineación comercial.

• Administrar el calendario maestro editorial y de campañas desde la perspectiva de comunicación de marca.

• Monitorear tendencias de comunicación, beauty, fashion, retail, social media, diseño, cultura digital y comportamiento del consumidor.

• Realizar benchmark competitivo y detectar oportunidades de diferenciación frente a marcas nacionales e internacionales.

• Dirigir agencias creativas, productoras, fotógrafos, videógrafos, copywriters y proveedores especializados.

• Establecer procesos de aprobación y control de calidad para materiales de comunicación.

• Presentar reportes ejecutivos de desempeño, consistencia y evolución de marca.




Perfil requerido

• Experiencia en posiciones gerenciales de Comunicación de Marca, Branding, Marketing Estratégico o áreas relacionadas.

• Experiencia desarrollando estrategias de comunicación integral y campañas 360°.

• Experiencia liderando equipos creativos y coordinando agencias o proveedores externos.

• Conocimiento en construcción de marca, identidad visual, narrativa, contenido y comunicación corporativa.

• Capacidad estratégica, liderazgo, organización y orientación a resultados.

• Habilidad para trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios y tomar decisiones alineadas al negocio.




Únete a Fashion Beauty Group

Forma parte de un grupo enfocado en construir marcas relevantes, diferenciadas y con impacto dentro de la industria de belleza, moda y retail.

About the job

Purpose of the Job

Drive the localization and adaptation of global marketing content to ensure regional relevance while preserving brand consistency and product intent. This role oversees localized asset governance, launch readiness, and translation workflows, executing content within internal platforms, managing launch timelines, and ensuring all materials meet quality, formatting, and brand standards prior to deployment.

Key Responsibilities


Translate and localize global product positioning, campaign copy, packaging materials, and messaging guides to ensure deep regional relevance without sacrificing core product intent.
Secure critical in-tool brand voice approvals, adapting global assets to meet local market nuances while strictly adhering to established brand governance and style guides.
Manage Plan of Record (POR) changes, maintain the overall launch agenda, and oversee toolkit governance to ensure all localized assets map perfectly to master product launch timelines.
Execute localization deliverables directly inside internal translation workbenches and existing tool-based workflows, navigating complex proprietary infrastructure efficiently.
Conduct comprehensive staging reviews to verify layout, formatting, and contextual accuracy of localized copy before public deployment.
Serve as the trusted, authorized user mandatory for bypassing secure access gates on internal translation platforms and secure staging infrastructure.


Knowledge, Skills + Experience


3–5 years of experience in product localization, copy adaptation, or transcreation—ideally within a fast-paced technology, hardware, or global consumer brand environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Translation Studies, Linguistics, International Business, Marketing, or a related field.
Native-level fluency in Spanish with flawless written adaptation skills, paired with professional working proficiency in English to collaborate with global product teams.
Ability to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across localized content, brand messaging, and launch materials while managing multiple deliverables simultaneously.
Skilled at adapting messaging for local audiences while preserving brand voice, demonstrating sensitivity to cultural nuances and market-specific needs.
Highly structured approach to managing timelines, approvals, content governance, and launch priorities within complex workflows and systems.
